t: Fortress 9Ltr Dark Oak Shed & Fence Stain offers a water-based wood treatment solution for protecting and enhancing outdoor timber structures. This quick-drying, low odour formula is ideal for garden sheds, fencing, and various rough sawn wood applications. It provides robust all-weather protection, becoming showerproof in just one hour and fully dry in four hours, ensuring long-lasting defence against moisture ingress. The rich dark oak colour effectively revitalises exterior wood, offering excellent coverage of 9m²/Ltr Its easy-clean properties also simplify future maintenance for tradespeople.
